raw_response: {"diagnosis": "In silver_transactions, txn_date is derived from ingest_ts, which lands the next day at 02:00 for every row. All 4558 POSTED rows therefore fail the DATE_CONSISTENCY check, which expects txn_date to equal the date of txn_ts. Deriving txn_date from txn_ts restores the intended transaction-date meaning, and the gold tables recompute from it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
